Band Salsa

Turn your night into a fiesta with Band Salsa — explosive Latin & Commercial Latin hits, big horns, big vocals, and nonstop dancing.

About Band Salsa

Introducing the electrifying Band Salsa — a vibrant 7-piece Latin &amp; Commercial Latin band guaranteed to set your dancefloor alight. Blending Latin , Commercial Latin , and Dance with show-stopping live energy, this powerhouse lineup combines a dynamic lead vocalist , sizzling sax/trumpet , infectious guitar , groove-heavy bass , keys , and driving drums for a sound that’s upbeat, fun, and unapologetically feel-good. Inspired by London’s iconic Bar Salsa nights, Band Salsa can help you recreate that “cocktails-then-dance” atmosphere — even adding an optional Latin dance instructor for your drinks reception so guests can learn a few spicy moves before the party kicks off. Fronted by vocalist Noëlle (a multilingual French-Spanish singer-songwriter with a Netflix credit for Bienvenidos a Edén ), the band delivers a fresh, modern edge while staying rooted in classic Latin rhythm. Expect crowd-pleasers from Shakira , Marc Anthony , J Balvin , plus timeless hits like “Bamboleo” and modern anthems like “Despacito.” With a huge 700+ song repertoire , Band Salsa welcomes setlist choices, can learn a special request (perfect for a first dance ), and is available as a space-friendly 5-piece . Add DJ-style playlists , optional live band-member DJing , and a full PA &amp; lighting package — and you’ve got entertainment sorted in one swoop.
